title: Tesla second-quarter 2026 production, deliveries and deployments
excerpt: Tesla produced 451,758 vehicles, delivered 480,126 vehicles, and deployed 13.5 GWh of energy storage in Q2 2026.
summary: Current issuer release reporting Q2 2026 production of 451,758 vehicles, deliveries of 480,126 vehicles, and energy-storage deployments of 13.5 GWh. Tesla cautions that deliveries and storage deployments alone do not determine financial performance because average selling price, costs, foreign exchange, and other factors also matter.
